hydrostaticArchitectures.name: Industrial High-Capacity Quad-Leg Hydrostatic Retort Cooker-Cooler (1,500 cans/min, 22m Tower, Dual Water Seal Loops)
hydrostaticArchitectures.classification: Commercial High-Throughput Continuous Canning (FDA 21 CFR § 113.40, ASME BPVC Section VIII & NFPA 86)
hydrostaticArchitectures.description: Massive 22-meter continuous industrial hydrostatic sterilizer engineered for high-volume canning of soups, pet foods, and vegetables. Features four vertical hydrostatic water legs (infeed preheat, hydrostatic seal, steam dome, discharge cooling, and hydrostatic pressure seal) that balance up to 150 kPa saturated steam pressure without physical mechanical valves. Incorporates automated continuous steam deaeration bleeders and ultrasonic water level transmitters to prevent explosive steam blowout.

hydrostaticArchitectures.name: Medium-Tower Dual-Leg Hydrostatic Sterilizer (750 cans/min, 16.5m Tower, Atmospheric Water Seal)
hydrostaticArchitectures.classification: Medium-Scale Continuous Commercial Retort (FDA 21 CFR 113 & OSHA 1910.106 Standard)
hydrostaticArchitectures.description: Mid-sized 16.5-meter continuous hydrostatic cooker-cooler for canned fish, dairy beverages, and sauces. Employs a dual-leg vertical barometric water seal with counter-flow preheat and cool zones. Features precision optical chain pitch monitors to detect wear elongation before sprocket climb occurs, coupled with automatic steam pressure regulators maintaining chamber equilibrium.

hydrostaticArchitectures.name: Flexible Multi-Zone Hydrostatic Retort System for Pouches & Plastic Bowls (500 units/min, Air Overpressure Seal, 18m)
hydrostaticArchitectures.classification: Specialty Retort Pouch & Fragile Packaging Sterilization (FSIS / USDA & FDA 21 CFR 113.40(e))
hydrostaticArchitectures.description: Specialized continuous hydrostatic processing tower configured for thin-walled aluminum containers, laminated foil retort pouches, and barrier plastic trays. Employs positive pneumatic air-overpressure balance inside hydrostatic legs (counterbalancing pouch internal seal stress up to 1.4 bar) and gentle cascading water heat transfer to prevent pouch bursting and seam delamination.

hydrostaticArchitectures.name: Aging Legacy Hydrostatic Retort (Partially Clogged Bleeders, Worn Carrier Chain, Level Sensor Drift)
hydrostaticArchitectures.classification: High-Risk Non-Compliant Industrial Retort (Severe Under-Processing, Steam Blowout & Can Peaking Risk)
hydrostaticArchitectures.description: Legacy 15-meter hydrostatic cooker suffering from mineral scale accumulation in top dome steam bleeders, chronic water level sight-glass fouling, and chain pitch wear (>1.8% elongation). Non-condensable air pockets form cold spots in the steam dome, depressing sterilization lethality (Fo < 3.0 min), while diminished water seal levels risk sudden catastrophic steam blowout onto processing floors.

containerFoodProfiles.name: Standard Tinplate Steel Can 300x407 (Condensed Soup / Stew, High Viscosity)
containerFoodProfiles.description: Standard commercial canned soup and vegetable container. Rigid tinplate body withstands internal vapor pressure up to 34 psi before end expansion (peaking). Requires balanced hydrostatic pressure drop during transition into the cooling leg to prevent negative pressure panelling.

containerFoodProfiles.name: Lightweight Aluminum Can 202x504 (RTD Coffee & Dairy Beverage, Convective)
containerFoodProfiles.description: Thin-gauge drawn and ironed (D&I) aluminum beverage can. Highly vulnerable to rapid pressure fluctuations; internal pressure exceeding 19.5 psi causes immediate double-seam peaking and permanent buckle, while entering cooling water too rapidly causes can body collapse.

containerFoodProfiles.name: Institutional Catering Can No. 10 (Tomato Paste & Baked Beans, 3 kg)
containerFoodProfiles.description: Large No. 10 commercial foodservice can holding ~3 kg of viscous food. Due to large end-diameter (157 mm), total hydrostatic force exerted on can ends is extreme (F = P · A). Very low peaking threshold (18 psi); requires slow hydrostatic pressure ramp and extended cooling dwell.

containerFoodProfiles.name: Retortable Multilayer Barrier Pouch (Tuna Fillet & Ready Meals, 250g)
containerFoodProfiles.materialType: PET / Aluminum Foil / Oriented Polyamide / Cast Polypropylene (CPP)
containerFoodProfiles.description: Flexible foil-laminated retort pouch. Zero mechanical stiffness; internal steam pressure instantly expands pouch walls against heat seal seams. Peaking/bursting threshold is only 9.5 psi, strictly mandating continuous hydrostatic air-overpressure balancing throughout processing.

chainAlloys.name: AISI 316L Austenitic Stainless Steel with Chrome Plating
chainAlloys.corrosionResistance: Excellent (Resistant to chlorine-treated cooling leg water and saturated steam condensate)

chainAlloys.name: SAE 8620 Case-Hardened Alloy Steel (Electroless Nickel Plated)
chainAlloys.corrosionResistance: Good (High mechanical tensile strength, moderate pitting resistance in chlorinated water)

chainAlloys.name: Uncoated Carbon Steel (Worn & Pitted Chain Links)
chainAlloys.corrosionResistance: Poor (Active rust pitting, accelerated bushing galling, and rapid pitch elongation)
